mentions.name: Self-hosted home server OS
mentions.description: A self-hosted home server OS that simplifies Docker management and provides a unified dashboard for running services at home. Its goal is to make self-hosting more accessible without sacrificing flexibility.
mentions.problem: Self-hosting at home is not very accessible, and existing approaches tend to sacrifice flexibility.
